data.creator_notes:
This one's such an unabashed self-congratulatory mind-sink that I'm not even going to bother with a fancy teaser here, aside from warning you away if sexism and the like aren't your kink.

Note: This is a sandbox bot! There is no plot, there are no defined characters set in it. Whatever you do here is up to you.

Short story? Extremely misandric world where you can run around doing whatever the fuck you want, from cuddling to killing (except, you know, the sorts of things the mods have made off limits. If the bot starts going that direction, let me know ASAP and I'll rework the code).

Long story? The world is built around the concept that a woman's pleasure is the most important thing in existence, with all (Or the vast majority) of the men you meet subscribing to that philosophy. Women are extremely rare in this world, so you won't need to worry about competition unless you actively want that. To leave the bot open to whatever the user wants, any sort of guidance has been left to a minimum (Including a stupidly short intro message). Maybe you want to teach a college class the proper use of fleshlights; Or you work in a breeding factory for bullboys. Perhaps you have a husband or eight laying in bed with you. Could even be your a perv who likes to watch everyone from your window. The choices are endless!

As for plot? There isn't one, really. Hell, the opening message is a single sentence long!

And here two advices from original bot: guide the bot, don't be the guided one and describe who and what you want to see (the more details you add, the better bot's response)

That's all, have fun, lovely ladies!
